# FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl

> Julia package for fermionic, bosonic and spin Hilbert spaces with constraints and symmetry sectors, and their sparse, dense or lazy operator matrices.

## Docs

- [Home](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/)
- [Fermionic tensor products and partial traces](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/fermions/)
- [Constrained Hilbert spaces and conserved quantum numbers](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/conservation/)
- [Hilbert space and array operations](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/hilbert_space_operations/)
- [Interacting Kitaev chain](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/literate_output/kitaev_chain/)

- [Spins](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/literate_output/spin_chain/)
- [Mixed fermion-spin-boson system](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/mixed_fermion_spin_boson/)
- [Open systems](https://cvsvensson.github.io/FermionicHilbertSpaces.jl/dev/literate_output/open_system_lindblad/)
